newsitem.title: KUWAIT: BankWatch rates Kuwait CBK, NBK.
newsitem.headline: BankWatch rates Kuwait CBK, NBK.

text.p: New York-based Thomson BankWatch said in a statement that it had assigned ratings to Commercial Bank of Kuwait (CBK) and affirmed ratings for the National Bank of Kuwait (NBK).

It said CBK was assigned an intra-country issuer rating of IC-B/C and a local currency rating of LC-1. "Under the new management, profitability improved dramatically in 1996 and is on track for another good year in 1997," it said.
BankWatch said NBK had "extended its excellent track record in 1996 and thus far in 1997" and maintained a dominant share of local corporate lending, customer deposits and private banking.

"We believe that the bank's unique balance sheet and strategy provide greater ability to endure regional and oil related shocks than most other banks in the Gulf. The bank deserves BankWatch's highest ratings."
It affirmed NBK's intra-country issuer rating of IC-A and its short-term local currency debt rating at LC-1.
